messages:
Jordan: Quick note  I've handed in my resignation, last day Wed 2026-10-07. I'm a manager with PagerDuty rotation, equity vesting questions, and admin access to analytics DB. Need a careful offboard plan so reports and on-call coverage aren't disrupted.
Priya: Thanks for the heads up Jordan. HR notes: COBRA notice will go out 2026-10-08; benefits end date in system 2026-10-21. Kelsey will schedule an exit interview and send equity/409A paperwork follow-up.
Kelsey-HR: I will send equity FAQ and vesting schedule today. Also confirm final paycheck date and PTO payout once Payroll-bot reports. Do you want alumni network opt-in?
Jordan: Opt-in yes. Also need to keep access to analytics read-only until Friday so I can finish a dashboard handoff.
Maya-IT: Proposed timeline:
- 09:00 final day: Slack status Away; block calendar
- 11:00 final day: remove admin from analytics, switch to read-only
- 13:00 final day: remove PagerDuty escalation membership; transfer rotation to Priya
- 15:00 final day: deactivate Okta and VPN
Commands I'll run (audit to JIRA):
```
oktactl deactivate-user --user jordan
pagerduty users deactivate --id <jordan-id>
psql -c "REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA analytics FROM jordan; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA analytics TO jordan_readonly;"
```
Sam-Security: Before rotations, snapshot active sessions and export 90 days of access logs for analytics work. If any long-lived tokens exist, rotate immediately. I'll validate after Maya posts proofs.
PagerDuty-bot: Reminder  transfer all on-call schedules owned by jordan to Priya before deactivation.
Payroll-bot: Final paycheck estimated 2026-10-14; PTO payout included. We will DM tax docs.
Jordan: Uploaded manager handoff, direct report status, and a list of active dashboards: https://drive.redwood.com/handovers/jordan-manager.pdf. I'll host a 45-min handoff Tue 10:30.
Priya: Scheduled handoff Tue 10:30. Maya/Sam please post rotation confirmations to OFFBOARD-4217. Kelsey please send equity follow-up.
Maya-IT: Completed analytics role change at 2026-10-07T11:05Z. Posted audit snippet to JIRA OFFBOARD-4217.
Sam-Security: Audit done  no lingering service tokens; exported logs attached.
Kelsey-HR: Equity packet and exit interview invite sent. COBRA notice queued.
Priya: Laptop courier label created; Jordan please drop at HQ or hand to Priya.
Jordan: Thanks all. I'll attend handoff and drop laptop Thu morning.
Priya: Closing loop once laptop received and all proofs are in OFFBOARD-4217. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
